mathematical_reconciliation.discrepancy_explanation: Theoretical 95% circular error probable for a 2-DOF bivariate Gaussian requires k = sqrt(chi2_2(0.95)) = 2.448. In historical V3.0.4/V3.0.5 development, k = 2.24 was empirically calibrated downward on calibration residuals to prevent excessive volumetric inflation of spatial bounding ellipses while maintaining empirical containment >= 0.95. Therefore, k = 2.24 is NOT the mathematical Chi-Square 95% quantile, and must strictly be cited as an 'empirically calibrated coverage factor' under 2D Gaussian assumptions.

fitting_method: Empirical grid search minimizing covariance bounding volume subject to empirical containment >= 95.0%
assumptions: Bivariate zero-mean Gaussian measurement residuals in camera ground plane projection
limitations: Calibrated in-sample on CAM02 calibration sequence (500 frames)
Valid only within nominal ODD boundaries
Degrades on non-planar surfaces (e.g. 3.5 deg ramp, FAIL-45) and shallow pitch (< 35 deg, FAIL-38)
Cannot provide an unconditional mathematical guarantee against non-Gaussian outliers
